title: Retain an unmatched full-launch window when a missing-authority diagnostic loses association
outcome: A missing-authority full launch whose diagnostic loses completion association cannot have its run borrowed by a later mediated gate in the same worktree.
acceptance: For a recognized full-gate start recorded without binding or grant and with a known root/start stamp, every diagnostic retirement that may leave a running or late-published run—mismatched completion, stale runtime/turn pruning, pending-cap eviction, and own abandonment—retains the original root/start unmatched window under the existing bounded policy before discarding diagnostic tracking.

A later ordinary mediated launch in the same root and run-search window cannot borrow such a retired launch's run for verification or batch-member credit. Unknown roots create no invented root; foreign/replaced/unowned observations cannot consume a current diagnostic; disabled observations remain silent.

Deterministic recorder-to-carry settlement regressions cover missing authority, mismatched completion, authority recovery, and an earlier unclaimed running or late-published run within search slack; retirement-route witnesses cover pruning, cap and abandonment. Matched ordinary carry still credits its own run. Use retained timestamps/barriers, not sleeps or retries.

Focused validation and an independent Codex/Claude Opus review pair cover the exact stack, with no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher; Merger runs the final exact Windows full gate and owns acceptance/landing. This package lands after w-ba7f and preserves its shared-argv, typed ACP command and qualified-full refusal controls.
